what_it_is: TAPAS-BH-201 (formerly Rustom-II) is DRDO's indigenous medium-altitude long-endurance UAV, developed by ADE with HAL as production partner. It has flown progressively higher and longer in user-evaluation trials, including service-operated sorties over the Arabian Sea with the Indian Navy.
india_angle: TAPAS is the flagship of India's indigenous MALE ambition: user-evaluation trials with the Army and Navy are public, and programme reviews have pushed performance targets toward operational thresholds. Its fate directly shapes India's import decisions for Herons and MQ-9Bs.

intelligence_assessment: Trial milestones are verifiable through DRDO and defence media, but the programme has publicly struggled to meet original end-user requirements. Watch the user-trial report and any limited-series production sanction as the decisive evidence.

faq.a: TAPAS has flown user-evaluation trials with the Indian Army and Navy; formal operational induction has not been announced.
